Overview

Welkom is a city in Free State with a population of 260,000. A gold mining city in the Free State, built on the rich goldfields of the Witwatersrand basin. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 280 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
